object.description: Stop each of these on a conflict in a document file, then mark the file resolved with `git add`: `git rebase`, `git cherry-pick`, and `git revert`. Also run cherry-pick and revert with --no-commit. In each state, change a document and commit from the commit dialog and through commit_changes. Expected: every commit is refused and HEAD doesn't move. Repeat in a linked worktree once MELLON-STORE-SRS-16 is accepted. No test exists.
